sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the existing IA Super/false-bulb applicability, exactly-one controlled iceClass and boolean checks, ship ownership, all operands, required units/datatypes, and strictly positive L/B/T constraints. Repair the SPARQL constraint's pass logic: its SELECT currently returns the ship when every required fact exists, so compliant data is reported as a violation while missing data can pass; select violations for missing, malformed, non-unique, or invalid facts instead. Also add the required numerical-tolerance validation for both derived C1 and C2 results, scaled from their expected formula results rather than using presence/unit checks only. Retain the COMPLEX_READINESS boundary: do not invent a mandatory formula execution or additional evidence obligation.
